docs.title: Twilio Examples in Go
docs.text:
Example code for building Twilio voice applications in Go: TwiML-driven call flows, outbound calls via the REST API, and real-time audio via Media Streams.

Guide Description Appointment Reminders TwiML server that speaks a reminder and handles keypad input with <Gather>. Outbound Call CLI that places a call through the Twilio Calls API. Media Streams Server that receives live call audio over a WebSocket and saves it as .ulaw/.wav.

docs.title: Shared Package
docs.text:
The root package (github.com/grokify/go-twilio-examples) provides helpers used by the examples:

  • api_call.go: Calls API URL builder and MakeCall
  • twiml_response.go: TwimlResponseProcess to encode and write a TwiML response
  • twiml_verb_start.go: <Start> and <Stream> TwiML verbs, built on grokify/twiml
  • twiml_event_gather.go: GatherEvent webhook parameters
  • stream_message.go: StreamMessage types for Media Streams WebSocket messages

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Go 1.26 or later
  • A Twilio account (Account SID, auth token, and a voice-capable number)
  • A public tunnel such as ngrok, since Twilio must reach your server

docs.title: Appointment Reminders
docs.text: A TwiML demo server. When Twilio requests /reminder_start, the server speaks an appointment reminder and offers a keypad menu (<Gather>); the chosen digit is handled at /reminder_process.

docs.title: Endpoints
docs.text: Path Purpose /reminder_start Answers the call and speaks the reminder /reminder_menu Plays the keypad menu /reminder_process Handles the digit pressed (1, 2 or 3)

docs.title: Run
docs.text:
No configuration is required. From the repository root:

go run ./appointment-reminders

The server listens on port 8081. Override with PORT:

PORT=8080 go run ./appointment-reminders

docs.title: Expose the server
docs.text: ngrok http 8081

docs.title: Place a demo call
docs.text: Use the Outbound Call example, setting TWILIO_DEMO_CALLBACKURL to https://<ngrok-host>/reminder_start.

docs.title: Media Streams
docs.text: A server that answers a call with TwiML <Start><Stream> and receives the call audio over a WebSocket. Inbound audio is saved to media_<timestamp>_<streamSid>.ulaw and .wav files in the working directory.

docs.title: Configure
docs.text: Variable Required Description BASE_URL_WSS yes Public WebSocket base URL, e.g. wss://<your-host>.ngrok.io PORT no Listen port, default 8080 HTTP_ENGINE no HTTP engine, default nethttp

docs.title: Run
docs.text:
ngrok http 8080
BASE_URL_WSS=wss://<your-host>.ngrok.io go run ./media-streams

Point your Twilio number's voice webhook at https://<your-host>.ngrok.io/voice.

docs.title: Audio format
docs.text: Twilio streams 8-bit mu-law mono at 8000 Hz (audio/x-mulaw). See the <Stream> reference.

docs.title: References
docs.text:
• Twilio <Stream> TwiML
  • Best Practices for Audio Recordings
  • Live Transcribing Phone Calls using Twilio Media Streams and Google Speech-to-Text
  • go-audio/wav
  • twilio/media-streams

docs.title: Outbound Call
docs.text: A CLI that places a call through the Twilio Calls API and points Twilio at a TwiML callback URL, such as the Appointment Reminders server.

docs.title: Configure
docs.text:
Copy the sample file and fill in your values. .env is gitignored; never commit it.

cd outbound-call
cp .env.sample .env
Variable Description TWILIO_DEMO_SID Twilio Account SID TWILIO_DEMO_TOKEN Twilio auth token TWILIO_DEMO_TO Number to call TWILIO_DEMO_FROM Your Twilio number TWILIO_DEMO_LOG Number for logging TWILIO_DEMO_CALLBACKURL TwiML URL, e.g. https://12345678.ngrok.io/reminder_start

An alternate .env location can be given with ENVPATH.

docs.title: Run
docs.text:
cd outbound-call
go run .

The program prints the loaded options as JSON, then the API status, for example Called with status [201]. The TWILIO_DEMO_TO number receives the call.

docs.title: Release Notes v0.1.0
docs.text: Release Date: March 21, 2021

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This release adds the Twilio Media Streams example and consolidates shared code at the repository root.

docs.title: Media Streams example
docs.text: The media-streams example serves TwiML containing <Start><Stream> and accepts the resulting WebSocket connection. Inbound audio is decoded and written to file. See the Media Streams guide.

docs.title: Stream message types
docs.text: StreamMessage and related types model the JSON events Twilio sends over a Media Streams WebSocket: connected, start, media, stop and mark.

docs.title: Changes
docs.text:
• Logging moved from logrus to zerolog.
  • Shared helpers moved to the repository root so the examples import one package.
  • GitHub Actions CI added; the cron schedule was later removed.
  • Dependencies and license updated.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: go get github.com/grokify/go-twilio-examples@v0.1.0

docs.title: Release Notes v0.2.0
docs.text: Release Date: October 20, 2026 (planned)

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This release adds a MkDocs documentation site with a guide for each example, removes the hardcoded host from the Media Streams example, and brings dependencies and tooling up to date.

docs.title: Breaking Changes
docs.text: Change Action media-streams requires BASE_URL_WSS and exits at startup without it Set BASE_URL_WSS=wss://<your-host>.ngrok.io before running Unused msg field removed from GatherEvent Remove any references to it Minimum Go version is 1.26 Upgrade your toolchain

docs.title: Documentation site
docs.text: mkdocs.yml and docs/ provide a Material for MkDocs site with guides for Appointment Reminders, Outbound Call and Media Streams. The per-example READMEs are now short pointers to these guides, and their stale paths were corrected.

docs.title: Configurable Media Streams host
docs.text: The WebSocket base URL is read from BASE_URL_WSS and used for both the <Stream> URL in the TwiML and the service router, instead of a hardcoded tunnel host.

docs.title: Bug Fixes
docs.text: • appointment-reminders: set ReadHeaderTimeout on the HTTP server.

docs.title: Other Changes
docs.text:
• processResponse no longer takes an unused request parameter.
  • CI workflows renamed to the standard go-ci, go-lint and go-sast-codeql; .golangci.yaml updated.
